notes: The supplied text is the Certificates tab of the Design discipline page. It contains no Architectural Design A.A. Degree section, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded for the degree. The degree is probably on a separate Degrees tab that was not captured.

The Certificate of Achievement in Architectural Design is printed. It has required courses DESN 100, 101, 102, 103, 105, 200, 201 and 207, plus DESN 290 or DESN 292 or DESN 299. It also requires at least 6 elective units from BUS 133, DESN 107, DESN 108, DESN 204, HORT 127 and MAT 110, for 32 Total Units. The degree may mirror this certificate; a reviewer should check the degree tab.

The certificate's Program Student Learning Outcome is 'Upon completion of this program, the student will be able to design and create graphical representations of the built environment based on industry standards.' It was not recorded because it is printed for the certificate, not the A.A. degree.
The certificate also names entry-level positions in detailing, revisions, design update, and general office practice. These were not recorded as careers for the A.A. degree.
